home.lead: We partnered with Good Boy Creative on the creation of the Champions Shanghai Opening Tease.
paragraphs: Our team had the opportunity to help develop the stylized visual direction throughout the animation.
We worked across different stages of the production, from character texturing to 3D animation, mattepainting, and 2DFX animation.

seoDescription: Champions Shanghai Opening Tease — a stylized animation by Raphy Studios in partnership with Good Boy Creative.

description.text:
We were challenged to develop a short cinematic of up to 20 seconds, and the Rush
 concept fit perfectly. We chose Jett as the protagonist, racing to save the game.

concept.text1: The project's first explorations were created to depict Haruto's dojo, Kenji's grandfather. It's an environment surrounded by mountains that will play an important role and be explored much further in Part 2 of the project.
concept.text2: Alongside that, we also created several color studies to define the mood of the opening scenes. This particular piece holds a special place for our team. It's one of our favorite explorations and perfectly captures the atmosphere we wanted to achieve.
